atlas_home_region_card.compact: The 1980s US punk pressure cooker: faster, cheaper, louder, and more self-organized.

region_scene_page.compact: Hardcore took punk's permission structure and rebuilt it through regional scenes, indie labels, vans, basement shows, and all-ages rooms.
region_scene_page.standard: Hardcore took punk's permission structure and rebuilt it through regional scenes, indie labels, vans, basement shows, and all-ages rooms. Dead Kennedys' California Uber Alles, Black Flag's Nervous Breakdown, Germs' What We Do Is Secret, and D.O.A.'s World War 3 give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Hardcore took punk's permission structure and rebuilt it through regional scenes, indie labels, vans, basement shows, and all-ages rooms. Speed, barked vocals, tight riffs, and anti-commercial infrastructure distinguish it from both first-wave punk and metal. Dead Kennedys' California Uber Alles, Black Flag's Nervous Breakdown, Germs' What We Do Is Secret, and D.O.A.'s World War 3 give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
